objects.name: Analytic 2160
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol library loaded by a Linux process not in the authorized ICS applications list, making connections to the device subnet. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): connect syscall from an ICS service/application process to a destination outside the approved network or vendor-service baseline

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: The complete, maintained inventory of every legitimate source-to-destination communication pair in the ICS environment.
